# ngspice parser fixtures

These `.raw` files are **trimmed captures from real ngspice 47 runs** made on
2026-11-24, not invented round-number samples. Each file keeps the original
`Title`, `Date`, `Command`, `Plotname`, `Flags`, `Variables` and value formatting
from the engine, with only some data points removed to keep the fixtures small.

Capture command used by `spice_engine.run_netlist`:

```text
ngspice -b -o run.log -r run.raw circuit.cir
```

Reference input: `VCC=12 V`, `R1=100 kΩ`, `R2=22 kΩ`, `RC=2.2 kΩ`, `RE=1 kΩ`,
`RL=10 kΩ`, `Cin=Cout=10 µF`, `SIN(0 0.01 1000)` and the documented
`QNPN_TEACH` model. Full netlists are generated by `build_netlist()`.

| File | Real points captured | Points kept (original indices) |
|---|---:|---|
| `op.raw` | 1 | all |
| `ac.raw` | 801 | `0, 100, 200, 300, 400, 499, 500, 600, 700, 800` |
| `tran.raw` | 508 | `0, 25, 50, 75, 82, 100, 432, 482, 507` |

The retained indices include the real AC peak (499), the low-frequency cutoff
region, the transient Vin/Vout peaks and the final transient time. `No. Points`
was updated to match each trimmed file and trailing spaces were stripped for a
clean diff; all other header fields and value rows are unchanged.

`NO_CROSS_RAW` in `tests/test_spice_engine.py` is intentionally a small
hand-authored edge case for the “no −3 dB crossing” branch; it is not one of
the parser's real-output fixtures.
